RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: phaos & claude
RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: Simple Browser
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Keyboard-driven sample browser and importer: instant prehear with waveform, folders and samples panes, find, bookmarks and folder paths, Beatsync (with a length), Interpolation and per-sample Semitone / Fine tune / Panning for everything it plays and loads, per-sample loop, trim, cut and loop crossfade before loading, undo / redo, and a Multi-Sample panel that builds Drumkit / Distribute / Layer instruments. Caps Lock reaches every control by keyboard. Press Help in the browser for all keys.
